# GRHM language reference (generated; schema 1)

GRHM is an S-expression language for web UI apps, compiled to React/TS/CSS.
One (app name ...) per program, plus optional (tests ...). Comments: ; to end of line.
Atoms: "strings", numbers, true/false/null, identifiers (kebab-case), :keywords.
Keyword props follow the op: (vstack :pad 24 :gap 8 child...). Dotted access: user.name.
Token refs: $primary reads (token primary ...). Route params {id} bind as strings.

Compact signatures below cover every operation. Run grhm reference --full for detailed operation descriptions; grhm codes <CODE> explains one diagnostic with worked repairs.

## declaration ops
(app name)
(theme)
(token name value)
(data)
(resource name url :default expr :poll n :live bool)
(state name init)
(local name init)
(page route name :title expr)
(component name)
(props)
(use module)
(db)
(table name)
(seed table)
(row)
(api)
(input)
(auth users-table :provider "s")
(enum name member...)
(env name :default "s")
(job name :every n)
(uploads :max-kb n :public bool :quota-mb n :user-quota-mb n)
(i18n)
(locale name)
(msg key text)
(dark)
(fn (alias defn) name)
(import name [js-name])
(import-default name)
(include path)
(tests)
(test name)

## expression ops
(+ x x ...)  (- x ...)  (* x x ...)  (/ x x ...)  (mod x x) remainder  (= x x)  (!= x x)  (< x x)  (> x x)  (<= x x)  (>= x x)  (and x x ...)  (or x x ...)  (not x)  (abs x)  (round x)  (floor x)  (ceil x)  (sqrt x)  (pow base exp)  (min x ...)  (max x ...)  (random) 0..1  (to-fixed digits x) -> string  (to-num x) -> number, or null when Number(x) is NaN (non-numeric strings, records)  (concat x ...) string interpolation  (to-str x)  (upper x)  (lower x)  (trim x)  (split sep s) -> list  (join sep xs) -> string  (replace from to s), all occurrences  (starts-with prefix s)  (ends-with suffix s)  (slice start end x), strings and lists  (arr ...) list literal  (count x) length of list or string  (map f xs)  (filter pred xs)  (find pred xs)  (some pred xs)  (every pred xs)  (reduce f init xs), f takes (acc x)  (sort-by key-fn xs), ascending  (reverse x)  (take n xs)  (drop n xs)  (nth i xs)  (first x)  (last x)  (append xs x) -> new list  (contains x needle), strings and lists  (range from to), to exclusive  (sum x)  (obj :key value ...) record literal  (get record key) dynamic field access  (keys record) -> own enumerable string keys  (values record) -> own enumerable values  (entries record) -> list of [key, value] pairs  (from-entries pairs) -> record; later duplicate keys win  (assoc record key value) -> new record with an own field; original unchanged  (dissoc record key) -> new record without the own field  (merge record ...) -> new record; later own fields win  (has-key record key) -> boolean; ignores inherited properties  (json-parse text) -> unknown JSON value; invalid JSON throws; guard with attempt  (json-stringify value) -> compact JSON string; an undefined top-level value becomes "null"  (flat-map f xs) -> concatenated callback results, flattened one level  (flatten xs) -> new list flattened one level  (unique xs) -> first occurrences; SameValueZero comparison, records compare by identity  (zip xs ys) -> pairs, stopping at the shorter list  (chunk positive-integer xs) -> consecutive lists, final chunk may be shorter; invalid size throws; guard with attempt  (group-by key-fn xs) -> record of lists keyed by String(key-fn item)  (regex-test pattern text [flags]) -> boolean; invalid pattern/flags throw; guard with attempt  (regex-find pattern text [flags]) -> full match and capture strings, or null; unmatched captures are undefined; invalid pattern/flags throw; guard with attempt  (regex-replace pattern replacement text [flags]) -> string; flags default to g; invalid pattern/flags throw; guard with attempt  (url-encode text) -> percent-encoded URL component  (url-decode text) -> decoded URL component; malformed escapes throw; guard with attempt  (date-iso epoch-ms) -> UTC ISO 8601 string; invalid date throws; guard with attempt  (date-parse text) -> epoch milliseconds, or null when unparseable; prefer ISO 8601 input  (clamp minimum maximum value) -> bounded number  (trunc x) truncate toward zero  (sign x) numeric sign, preserving zero and NaN  (sin x) sine, input in radians  (cos x) cosine, input in radians  (tan x) tangent, input in radians  (asin x) inverse sine, result in radians  (acos x) inverse cosine, result in radians  (atan x) inverse tangent, result in radians  (atan2 y x) -> angle in radians  (exp x) e raised to a power  (log x) natural logarithm  (log10 x) base-10 logarithm  (or-else x fallback), fallback when x is null/undefined  (is-null x)  (not-null x)  (attempt expr fallback), fallback if expr throws  (now) current time, ms since epoch  (date-str ms) -> localized date string  (path x ...) route template  (fmt "Hi {name}" :name x) string template  (t msg-key :param expr ...) localized message (see i18n)  (cond (test value)... (else value))  (match x (literal value)... (else value)); exhaustive over enums
(call target.path arg...) — interop invocation; browser globals: window document console localStorage sessionStorage navigator location history fetch alert confirm prompt

## functions
(fn name (a b) body-expr) — top-level pure function; recursion and mutual recursion allowed.
Body sees params, other fns, imports, browser globals — never state or resources.
Call: (name arg...). Pass as value: (map name xs).
(lambda (x) expr) — anonymous function, usable wherever a function is expected.
(let ((x e1) (y e2)) body) — sequential local bindings, an expression.
(if cond then else) — in expression position, a value-producing conditional.
Conditions (if/when/cond tests, and/or/not operands) must be boolean: test other values with (not-null x), (!= n 0), (> (count xs) 0).
Example: (fn total (xs) (reduce (lambda (acc x) (+ acc (* x.price x.qty))) 0 xs))

## server (db + api)
(db (table name (col type [:default v])...)) — column types: auto string number boolean; auto is the integer primary key. Compiles to SQLite behind a generated node:http server (src/gen/server.ts; grhm dev runs it).
(api (get "/api/x" handler) ...) — methods: get post put delete. A handler is one expression over route params (bound by name, as strings), body (JSON request body), fns, and imports — never state.
Server-only handler ops: (select table [:where cond] [:order col] [:desc true] [:limit n] [:offset n]) -> rows; :where compiles to SQL over column refs  (insert table :col expr ...) -> created row  (update table :id expr :col expr ...) -> updated row  (delete-row table :id expr) -> {ok}  (fail status "message") -> abort the handler with an HTTP error  (tx expr) -> run expr inside a transaction, rolling back on failure
The whole stdlib works in handlers: (get "/api/top" (take 5 (sort-by (lambda (r) r.score) (select rows)))).
Pages read via (resource name "/api/x" ...) and mutate via actions:
(send post|put|delete "/route-or-(path ...)" :prop expr...) — JSON mutation; must match a declared api route.
(refresh resource-name) — re-fetch a resource after a mutation.

## actions
(set state-name expr) | (nav "/route") | (nav (path "/p/{id}" :id expr)) | (call ...) | (send ...) | (refresh name) | action-prop-name
Events wrap actions: (click a...), (change a...), (submit a...).

## test steps
(visit route) (click node-or-string) (fill node-or-string string) (press string) (expect-text string) (expect-node node-or-string) (expect-gone string) (expect-count node-or-string number) (expect-value node-or-string string) (expect-url route) (expect-eq expr expr) (screenshot string)

## patch protocol
(patch :revision "r" :target node-id
  (set prop value) (delete prop) (append form) (insert-before form)
  (insert-after form) (replace form) (move :before|:after|:into node-id))
Node IDs are stable across formatting; read them from grhm check --json / inspect.

## diagnostic codes
E001 Lexical error (bad character, escape, or unterminated string)
E002 Unexpected closing parenthesis
E003 Unclosed parenthesis
E004 Compiler source, token, or nesting budget exceeded; split or simplify the source
E101 Unknown operation
E102 Unknown property for this operation
E103 Invalid property value
E104 Invalid positional arguments (wrong count or type)
E105 Keyword property is missing a value
E106 Missing required property
E107 Duplicate declaration name
E108 Duplicate route
E109 Invalid expression
E110 Form is not allowed in this position
E111 Type mismatch in expression
E112 Wrong number of arguments
E201 Unknown reference
E202 Target of set is not writable state
E203 Navigation target does not match any route
E204 Invalid resource field (allowed: data, loading, error)
E205 Unknown design token
E206 Route parameter missing or unknown
W301 Resource data read without acknowledging loading/error states
W401 Image is missing alt text
W402 Button has no accessible label
E501 Patch target or property not found
E502 Invalid patch move
E503 Patch or fix would produce an invalid program
E504 Patch or fix revision conflict
W501 Patch has no revision precondition
E601 Invalid interop declaration or call
W601 Unchecked interop call (validated only by TypeScript at build time)
E602 Interop module not found
W602 Interop package not installed in node_modules
E603 Include could not be resolved (missing file, cycle, unsafe path, or project budget)
E701 Invalid test step
E801 Malformed db/table/column/seed declaration
E802 Unknown table
E803 Unknown column or row field
E804 Malformed or duplicate api route
E805 Invalid handler expression
E806 send targets no declared api route
E807 refresh targets an unknown resource
E808 Unknown or invalid request body field
E809 send body does not match the route input contract
E810 insert is missing a required column
E811 Invalid select query (:where/:order must use table columns)
E812 Unknown enum member
E813 Invalid auth declaration or :auth without (auth ...)
E814 Unknown i18n message key
W701 Message key missing from a non-default locale
E815 Invalid or non-exhaustive match expression
E816 :live requires the generated API server (a db or api declaration)
E817 Invalid job declaration
E818 Invalid uploads declaration or file-input without (uploads ...)
E819 :references targets an unknown table
W801 Operation may throw at runtime; wrap in (attempt expr fallback)
E900 Internal compiler error

## complete example
```
(app shop
  (theme (token primary "#4f46e5"))
  (data (resource products "/api/products.json" :default (arr)))
  (state cart-count 0)
  (use "./lib/util.ts" (import slugify))

  (page "/" home
    (vstack :pad 24 :gap 16 :enter fade-up
      (heading 1 "Shop")
      (btn "View cart (" cart-count ")" :variant primary
        (click (nav "/cart")))
      (if products.loading
        (txt "Loading...")
        (grid :cols 3 :cols-sm 1 :gap 16
          (each p products.data :key p.id
            (product-card :name p.name :price p.price
              :on-view (nav (path "/p/{id}" :id p.id))))))))

  (page "/p/{id}" detail
    (vstack :pad 24
      (heading 2 "Product " id)
      (btn "Add to cart" (click (set cart-count (+ cart-count 1))))))

  (page "/cart" cart
    (vstack :pad 24 (heading 2 "Cart: " cart-count " items")))

  (component product-card
    (props (name string) (price number) (on-view action))
    (card :gap 8
      (txt name :weight semibold)
      (money price)
      (btn "View" (click on-view)))))

(tests
  (test "home renders" (visit "/") (expect-text "Shop")))
```
